headlines.snippet: After hours of searching, the armed suspect who fled from an olive grove in Kfar Kara was arrested. He was located and apprehended following extensive searches involving police, border police, and helicopters. An M-16 rifle, concealed in the ground, was found near the scene. The suspect has been transferred for investigation, and the motive remains under review. Earlier reports indicated the suspect was wearing khaki uniforms and fled after civilians tried to alert him.

headlines.snippet: The American president was asked if he trusts Prime Minister Netanyahu and replied, 'In politics, I don't trust any person.' The American president was interviewed on NewsMax, where he revealed that Israeli officials would like him to interfere in the election system. Trump emphasized in the interview that he would not use nuclear weapons against Iran but added that the situation in the Temple Mount is being monitored, stating, 'We will shoot it and destroy it quickly.' He also added about Netanyahu: 'We had good relations and successes.'

headlines.snippet: Hamas earns an estimated NIS 250 million per month from aid entering Gaza. The terrorist organization imposes levies on merchants in the Strip, collecting thousands of shekels for each truckload of goods entering Gaza. Estimates suggest Hamas garners approximately NIS 3 billion annually from these trucks intended for the private sector. Additionally, hundreds of aid trucks enter the Strip daily, and security forces estimate Hamas's income to be even higher.
